remove_notice: Restore boot/login with administrator authentication first, then restore the user package to its original baseline. Personal files and backups are kept. Cancelling authentication leaves the user installation unchanged.
conflict_notice: Изменённые файлы и настройки защищены. Устраните конфликты перед повторной попыткой.

legacy_notice: Существующие настройки XP являются исходным состоянием этого компьютера. Старые копии остаются отдельно.
login: Boot/login: separate administrator installation and rollback. Enable Welcome under Components.
update_notice: Скачайте проверенную версию и откройте её launch.py. Исходная копия сохранится.
title: Настройки темы
session_appearance: Загрузка и вход в стиле XP
diagnostic_notice: Saved locally. No passwords, personal paths, file lists or raw logs are included. Nothing was uploaded.
rescue_notice: Save your work before recovery. Run as your desktop user, without sudo; the system step requests administrator authentication itself. The retained recovery copy also works if the installed GUI is damaged.
tray: Сворачиваемая область уведомлений XP с избранным
addons_notice: Optional upstream applications: Minesweeper XP, Solitaire, JS Paint and Space Cadet. Install individually; nothing is selected automatically. Existing installations are protected. Theme removal keeps these applications; remove manager-installed applications here separately. Saved games and drawings are always retained.
addon_license_notice: This downloads the upstream application and, where needed, its private runtime. Sources and SHA-256 fingerprints are listed in assets/addons/downloads.json. Minesweeper builds its locked frontend locally (npm registry downloads); Java is private to Solitaire. Code licences do not necessarily cover all inherited pictures, fonts or trademarks. A notice cannot grant missing rights. These third-party payloads are not redistributed in the public theme archive. Internet and temporary disk space are required. Review the source notices before installation.
addon_pinball_notice: The Flathub build downloads original Pinball data as extra-data from Archive.org. The engine MIT licence does not license those original game resources. Installation is optional and requires appropriate rights to that data. Existing user/system Flatpaks are reused. New installation uses user scope; shared Flatpak runtimes and the Flathub remote are retained on removal.
addon_remove_notice: Remove only this application installed by this manager. Saved games, preferences, drawings and pre-existing installations remain. Close the application before removing it. This does not uninstall the desktop theme.
addon_recover_notice: Recover an interrupted local transaction. For an uncertain Flatpak operation, keep the application and treat it as an external, protected installation instead of guessing ownership.
sound_preserve: Keep existing event choices for files in this soundpack
sound_notice: Звуки не включены. Без выбранного пакета текущие звуки не изменяются. Сначала выберите значки и звуки. Оригиналы Microsoft не включены; импорт не предоставляет лицензию. Используйте только файлы, на которые у вас есть необходимые права.
sound_undo_notice: Restore the sound settings from before installation and remove only the managed sound copy? Original files and the rest of the desktop are kept. A backup is made first.
sound_limits: Supported audio: PCM WAV, mono/stereo. Archives: ZIP, RAR, 7z and TAR (also gzip, bzip2, xz). Password-protected or multipart archives and nested archives must be unpacked first. Up to 512 WAV files, 16 MiB per file and 128 MiB in total. Missing and ambiguous assignments are shown. Only events actually emitted by applications can play sounds; existing volume and feedback settings are preserved.
sound_summary: {files} source files, {aliases} application event aliases, {events} Cinnamon/volume/bell assignments.
sound_import_required: Свои звуки — папка или архив — Back up, import and activate
sound_ambiguous_notice: Several different files match these events. Select the version you want for each event. Nothing is activated until the assignment preview is confirmed.
sound_backup_notice: Back up the current state and activate this soundpack? Your original files and archive are kept.
sound_preview_failed: Could not play the preview. Check your audio output.
completion_empty: Your summary appears here after a successful installation or change.
completion_relogin: Please log out and back in once to reload all desktop components.
completion_no_relogin: These settings normally do not require logging in again.
completion_optional: Additional steps below show their actual status. Existing games are preserved; remove managed games separately under Games and accessories.
setup_scope: Install everything selects the desktop, all four games/accessories and boot/login appearance. Downloads require internet; boot and login need administrator authentication. Existing games are preserved. Original Microsoft sounds and icons are not included.
system_install_notice: Boot and login appearance are installed at the start, using the administrator prompt before desktop changes and downloads. Cancelling stops installation. System files and boot images are backed up first. No automatic reboot.
install_partial: The desktop was set up, but some additional steps did not finish. See the download or administrator-authentication details above. You can select these steps again.

prefer_local_icons: Prefer existing local XP icons; use original project icons as fallback
icon_rights: Imported files stay private. Owning an ISO does not grant additional usage or redistribution rights.

compact_install_note: Install everything also selects games, boot and login. Review and authentication come before changes.

applet_notice: Эти апплеты могут отличаться от стиля XP. Все отмечены; изменения начнутся после выбора. Отключение убирает их только с панели. Удаление темы восстановит их.

media_steps: 1. Выберите ISO, архив или папку. 2. Проверьте. 3. Установите внизу. ISO может содержать значки и звуки.

conflict_help: Управляемый файл изменён вне установщика. Изменение защищено. Сохраните файл и сравните его с резервной копией перед заменой. Подробности ниже.
